description: This file contains Redux reducer functions for managing integrations-related state in a Mattermost application, including incoming/outgoing webhooks, commands, OAuth apps, OAuth connections, bot IDs, and dialog data.

methods.name: incomingHooks
methods.description: Reducer for managing incoming webhook objects, handling actions for receiving, deleting, and channel deletion effects.

methods.name: incomingHooksTotalCount
methods.description: Reducer for tracking total count of incoming hooks.

methods.name: outgoingHooks
methods.description: Reducer for managing outgoing webhook objects, handling actions for receiving, deleting, and channel deletion effects.

methods.name: commands
methods.description: Reducer for managing slash commands, handling receiving, updating tokens, and deletion.

methods.name: systemCommands
methods.description: Reducer for managing built-in slash commands, keyed by trigger.

methods.name: oauthApps
methods.description: Reducer for managing OAuth applications, handling receiving, deletion, and updates.

methods.name: appsOAuthAppIDs
methods.description: Reducer for list of OAuth app IDs, maintaining sorted order and handling resets on logout.

methods.name: outgoingOAuthConnections
methods.description: Reducer for managing outgoing OAuth connection objects.

methods.name: appsBotIDs
methods.description: Reducer for list of bot IDs, maintaining sorted order and handling resets on logout.
